nodes.title: 🕯 GESTO
widgets_values: Locked-off static camera on a tripod, medium shot. The framing never changes: no zoom, no push-in, no cuts, the same composition as the first frame for the entire video. The person in the image talks directly to the camera with natural lip movement, subtle head motion and blinking. The background stays the same.
